reviews.review:
The graphics are a bit rough and the game is sort of clunky but it's interesting and fun. Different classes to buy and add to your team. I wish there was class evolution. There is leveling up, though. 

Yea it is kinda hard to level up appropriately to keep up with the progressing difficulty of the game, exp is not generous enough, So even on easy mode, after a 30-40 or so turns on the world map, your units are significantly weaker than the enemies and there isn't much you can do except build a training bunker that gives your guys experience every world map turn. But I wouldn't say it's enough to keep up with the enemies' growth rate. 

I hope they make adjustments to this. But how hard is it to play your own game to experience this for yourself rather than the player having to be the test? Easy mode should actually be kind of easy and not be hopelessly outclassed by higher level enemies. there is easy, normal, and challenge modes by the way. So yea I don't even want to look at what the challenge mode is like.
reviews.developer_response:
The hit acc and evasion rate calculations by difficulty level have been changed from additive to multiplicative, giving greater reductions to tier-2 and tier-3 enemies. Conversely, tier-1 units that previously had negative evasion values will now have their penalties reduced.
The update has just been applied. If you are already logged in to the Steam launcher, please close it and log in again.
